notes.title: Everybody’s GOLF Hot Shots Update Details - 1.0.2
notes.notes: [h3]Thank you for your continued support of Everybody’s GOLF Hot Shots. We would like to inform you of the contents of the update released on September 12th, 2025.[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]▼Update Details[/b][/h3][h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed and adjusted issues such as progression stopping in Online GOLF.[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the "Group Match" mode to display the time limit when other players are operating.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fixed progression stopping issues in World Tour.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed progression stopping and other issues related to gameplay.[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would become unable to progress if "Shot Start Camera" in "Game Settings" was set to "5" and certain conditions were met.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where holing out under certain conditions would result in an OB (out of bounds) penalty.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would become unplayable near shrubs and grass.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fixed issues with VTR.[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a problem where club set data was not being saved. (Past data will not be played back correctly if you play VTR using club sets other than Normal.)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Other: Fixed several other issues.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3]
